#### 6.6.9.1 Reporting of horizon actions in the mobile robot's state

The mobile robot's state shall always represent the full status of the order it currently has. Therefore, the robot shall report both the `actionsStates` of actions included in its base as well as horizon at all times. All horizon actions are reported as 'WAITING'. If the mobile robot receives an order update where part of its former horizon is removed or changed, all actions that were attached to these nodes and edges shall be removed from the `actionStates` to reflect this. `actionStates` of base actions shall never be removed in the context of an `orderUpdate` as the base cannot be modified once released.

per_question.ground_truth: According to the action state transition diagram (Figure 21), an action can be in the following states: WAITING, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, PAUSED, RETRIABLE, FINISHED, and FAILED. From the 'RUNNING' state, the possible transitions are: (1) to 'PAUSED' — triggered by an external trigger (e.g., pause button, safety field violation). (2) to 'RETRIABLE' — when the action does not complete successfully but is marked as retriable. (3) to 'FAILED' — when the action is aborted via cancelOrder, switch to manual mode, or the action finally failed. (4) to 'FINISHED' — when the action returned the desired result, or possibly after abort via cancelOrder if the action cannot be interrupted and must finish. Notably, there is no transition from RUNNING back to WAITING or to INITIALIZING.
